{How did a young Bobby Fischer start a devastating attack before his opponent
was able to castle?} 10. Nd5 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find the
best square for your c3 knight.] [%hint Offer a trade to open the e-file.]} (
10. e5 $5 {This is a good move, but there's an even better one. Try to
centralize a piece and make a threat.}) (10. Ba3 $5 d6 {This is a good move,
but there's an even better one. Try to centralize a piece and make a threat.})
10... Nxd5 {Great move! How should you recapture?} 11. exd5 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try to find the best capture.] [%hint Recapture with a threat.]} (
11. Bxd5 $2 O-O {White doesn't have enough compensation for the missing pawns.
Try again.}) 11... Ne5 {Nice move! How can you prevent Black from completing
development?} 12. Nxe5 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find a good
capture.] [%hint Trade pieces to draw out Black's queen.]} (12. d6 $5 {This is
a good move, but Fischer found an even better one. Try to find a good capture.}
) (12. Bb2 $2 Nxc4 {White is only slightly better. Try to find a stronger move.
}) (12. Ba3 $2 Nxf3+ {White is only slightly better. Try to find a stronger
move.}) (12. Re1 $2 Bxe1 {Black is winning. Try again.}) 12... Qxe5 {Great
move! How can you continue to develop with a threat?} 13. Bb2 {[%wrong There's
a stronger move. Try to find a way to attack the black queen.] [%hint Develop
a new piece and target the black queen.] Well played! White is fully developed
and Black's king won't survive for long.} (13. Ba3 $5 {This is a good move,
but there's a more forcing option. Try to find it.}) (13. d6 $2 O-O {Black is
better. Try to find a way to attack the black queen.}) 1-0
